findings.title: Authorization uses tx.origin
findings.message: tx.origin can be a user-controlled call-chain identity and should not guard access.
findings.remediation: Use msg.sender with an explicit role or ownership check, then add an access-control test.

findings.title: State write follows an external call
findings.message: State variable `credits` is written after this external call.
findings.remediation: Apply checks-effects-interactions: update state before the external call and consider a reentrancy guard.

findings.title: Low-level call result is discarded
findings.message: The success flag returned by call or delegatecall is ignored.
findings.remediation: Capture and check the success flag, or use a typed call that reverts on failure.
